Compare a first-time viewer's understanding of a promo clip with the truth.
TRUTH (from the show bible, for episodes E6): Premise: [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her.
Mayor Brisk (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 53 lines between E1 and E14
Widow Halloran (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 45 lines between E1 and E14
Tobin The Ferryman (a man in period dress): [mock] speaks 40 lines between E1 and E14
Corin (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 37 lines between E1 and E14
Mara (a figure in period dress): [mock] speaks 28 lines between E1 and E14
Arc [mock] Part 2: Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship.
E6: The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara.
CLIP: [On screen: Medium two-shot of the figure in period dress and the man in period dress, the space between them charged.]
a figure in period dress: "If I say yes, the harbour keeps its tongue."
[Sound: A heartbeat pulse rises toward the cliffhanger.]
[On screen: Tight shot on a silver ring glinting in candlelight.]
[Action: the widow kneels on the slick quay boards.]
a figure in period dress: "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
[On screen: Slow push-in on the figure in period dress as the lamp flickers behind them.]
a figure in period dress: "Take the girl to the cells until morning."
[On screen: Extreme close-up on the figure in period dress's eyes, wet with sea spray.]
a figure in period dress: "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
[On screen: Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.]
a figure in period dress: "I kept that light burning for eleven winters."
[On screen: Close-up on the widow's hands gripping the rail.]
a figure in period dress: "Nobody leaves this hall until I say so."
[On screen: Slow push-in on the the figure in period dress as the lamp flickers behind them.]
a figure in period dress (off-screen): "Drink deep, little lamp-keeper."
[On screen: Close-up on the figure in period dress's hands gripping the rail.]
a man in period dress: "They are coming up the cliff path with lanterns!"
VIEWER ANSWERS: {"main_character":"a figure in period dress","what_they_want":"[mock] to be believed and get out of this moment","conflict":"[mock] pressure from a figure in period dress (off-screen)","left_wondering":"[mock] what comes after: \"They are coming up the cliff path with lanterns!\"","need_next":4,"confusing":["Drink","Nobody","Order"]}

"open_question" = 1 only if the viewer names a specific unresolved question the clip sets up.
